text:
tara: Heads up — small QA on the release notes before cut. We keep getting mixed tone (some too chatty). Can we agree on voice and who owns an entry? pinging @dmitri @olivia @mike :wave:

dmitri: SG. what's the preferred voice? terse bullets or short sentence? example?

olivia: Prefer concise bullets, present-tense, no marketing fluff. e.g., 'Improve cache eviction to reduce tail latency' :+1:

mike: :+1: agreed. Also can we require component tags and an `author` field on each entry? saves chasing during rollup.

release-bot: Reminder: `changelog-lint` will run on merges and flag missing `author` or `component` metadata.

tara: OK let's standardize. Proposed template (one-liner + component + owner + impact). Putting a short example below.

```
- One-line summary of change (present tense).
  component: serving/runtime
  author: olivia
  impact: low|medium|high
```

jen: Looks good. Can we add a short requirements checklist in the PR body to prompt authors? :memo:

olivia: impact tag makes sense, especially for perf/security. Also please keep examples in the PR template so people copy them rather than inventing prose.

dmitri: I'll add the new fields to the changelog-lint rules and drop a PR updating the repo template. ETA ~2h.

tara: Thanks — practical Q: what's the cutoff for this release? Need final entries and tone checks in before branch cut.

mike: We're cutting the release branch at 16:00 PT tomorrow. Please have entries merged by 15:30 PT so we can do the sweep.

jen: I'll sweep entries for tone/author at 15:45 PT and ping any fixes.

dmitri: PR for lint + template update is in flight, pinging here when merged.

tara: Awesome, thanks everyone :tada:

mike: Quick note — if anyone's unsure about wording, drop the draft in #eng-releases and we'll help rephrase (short + factual).

olivia: Cool, I'll reformat my open PRs to match the template now.

release-bot: Automation note: changelog-lint ruleset v2 will start enforcing `impact` next release after this merge.

tara: Great. Final ask: add yourself as `author` on any entries you open today to avoid follow-up. Cheers.
